description: Get the current price of a trading pair, along with its 24h change and volume, from a connected exchange. Use it for a quick spot-price check or to confirm the market before sizing or placing a trade. Read-only — never places orders. For historical OHLCV data use get_candles.

exchange.description: Optional exchange to price from: an exchange account ID from list_exchanges, or a platform name as list_exchanges shows it (e.g. "binance", "bybit"). Omit to use the default connected exchange.

symbol.description: Trading pair in BASE/QUOTE format, e.g. "BTC/USDT" or "ETH/USDT".

name: get_price
